editorial.blurb: A beloved local Italian deli serving generous, authentic dishes with genuinely warm service in a no-frills family-style setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the rigatoni with vodka sauce or skirt steak risotto for standout mains; call ahead for takeout to ensure hot food arrives wrapped tight, and go early evening for a lively but manageable crowd.
signatureDishes: Spaghetti with red sauce and meatballs
